response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior full-stack engineer with ~15 years of experience across web, mobile, and backend systems, including some high-throughput work at Dunnhumby. However, the role demands Principal-level (IC6) leadership in growth/experimentation systems, and the resume shows no experimentation platform, feature-flagging, A/B testing, or telemetry/metrics infrastructure experience, nor evidence of architecting cross-team platforms or leading multi-workstream initiatives at enterprise scale. The profile reads as a strong hands-on senior IC rather than a principal engineer specializing in experimentation and measurement.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering track record (15+ years) across required languages including JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, and C#
Real high-scale experience: low-latency microservices handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Recent AI-agent tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) aligns with the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, or statistical analysis of experiments
No evidence of Principal-level scope: no cross-team platform ownership, multi-workstream leadership, or org-wide architectural influence
No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or growth-engineering background, which is the core domain of the role

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
